beginner.summary: For operations engineers, developers and DevOps engineers who are starting site reliability engineering. Covers SRE principles, a lab with the course service and its monitoring stack, availability targets and the cost of nines, SLIs, SLOs and error budgets, error budget policies, golden signals, RED and USE, burn-rate alerting, logs, metrics and traces, toil, incident response, on-call, blameless postmortems, release engineering, capacity planning and load testing, overload protection, production readiness reviews, chaos experiments and systematic troubleshooting. Covers the DevOps Institute SRE Foundation topics.
prerequisites: Runs or supports a web application in production or test
Comfortable with Linux, the command line and basic scripting
Has used a monitoring tool or dashboard
outcomes: Set SLIs, SLOs and error budget policies with product owners
Build monitoring and burn-rate alerts that page only for user-facing problems
Run incidents, on-call rotations and blameless postmortems
Plan capacity, release safely, protect services from overload and troubleshoot systematically

days.topic: SRE Overview: Reliability as a Feature

Engagement models: embedded, consulting and platform SRE
Nines and the downtime they allow

The DevOps Institute SRE Foundation exam
Course project overview: a three-tier web service with real users

days.deliverable: Service map with critical journeys and downtime budgets

days.deliverable: Signed error budget policy and scenario decision
checks: The policy states triggers, actions and owners

days.topic: Monitoring Distributed Systems: Golden Signals, RED and USE

objectives: Apply golden signals, RED and USE

intermediate.summary: For SREs and senior operations engineers who run services in production. Covers SLO tooling and catalogues, latency SLOs with histograms, dependency and critical path analysis, tracing for SREs, major incident command, incident analysis, runbooks and automated remediation, Kubernetes reliability, database reliability, disaster recovery tests, load balancing, chaos engineering programmes, deployment safety, observability pipelines, alert quality, capacity forecasting, performance engineering, reliability for AI services and AIOps and SRE agents.
prerequisites: Has set SLOs and burn-rate alerts for a service

Prove disaster recovery, database and Kubernetes reliability with tests and experiments
Control telemetry cost, plan capacity and apply SRE practices to AI services and AI assistants

days.topic: Major Incident Command: Coordination, Escalation and Customer Communication

days.topic: Incident Analysis: Contributing Factors, Learning Reviews and Trends

days.topic: Runbooks and Automated Remediation

checks: The known failure is fixed without a human
The risky action waits for approval

days.topic: Load Balancing and Traffic Management for Reliability

days.topic: Multi-Region Architecture for High Availability
days.lab_task: Design an active-active, cell-based version of the course service with static stability, list shared dependencies that break isolation and plan a regional evacuation test.
days.deliverable: Multi-region design and evacuation test plan
checks: Shared dependencies are listed with mitigations
The evacuation test has steps, abort criteria and success measures

days.topic: Global Traffic Engineering and Failover Automation
days.lab_task: Automate health-based failover between two regions, prevent a thundering herd on recovery and run a failover test under load.
days.deliverable: Failover automation and load test results
checks: Traffic moves away from the failing region automatically
The test under load meets the SLO

days.topic: Cross-Organisation Incident Management and Regulator Notifications
subtopics: Incidents that span companies and vendors
days.lab_task: Run a cross-company exercise for a supplier outage that affects customers, meet notification deadlines and coordinate with security responders.
days.deliverable: Exercise record with notifications and lessons
checks: Joint command with the supplier works
Notifications are sent within their deadlines

days.topic: Resilience Engineering: Safety-II, Adaptive Capacity and Near Misses
subtopics: Work as imagined compared with work as done
Complex systems and multiple contributing factors
days.lab_task: Collect and analyse five near misses through interviews, describe the adaptations that prevented incidents and recommend ways to support them.
days.deliverable: Near-miss analysis and recommendations
checks: Adaptations that prevented incidents are described
objectives: Record the cause and a follow-up action for each near miss

days.topic: Continuous Chaos in Production: Automated Experiments and Guardrails
subtopics: Experiments tied to SLOs and error budgets
Chaos for data and stateful systems
days.lab_task: Automate weekly production experiments that stop when the error budget drops below a threshold, include a regional dependency failure and report resilience trends.
days.deliverable: Automated production experiments and trend report
checks: Experiments run on schedule with guardrails
An experiment stops when the budget threshold is reached
Resilience trends are reported over time

days.topic: Reliability of Data Systems: Freshness, Correctness and Pipeline SLOs
days.lab_task: Define freshness and correctness SLOs for two pipelines, detect a seeded data incident, backfill safely and add a data contract check.
days.deliverable: Data SLOs, incident record and contract check
checks: Pipelines have freshness and correctness SLOs
The data incident is detected by the SLIs
The backfill restores correct data without duplicates

days.topic: Observability Strategy: Telemetry Standards, Cost and Vendor Choices
subtopics: Comparing vendors on cost and features
days.lab_task: Write an observability strategy with telemetry standards, a vendor comparison and a cost model, and plan a migration of two teams to the chosen backend.
days.deliverable: Observability strategy and migration plan
checks: Telemetry standards cover names, attributes and retention
Vendors are compared on cost and needs
The migration plan avoids monitoring gaps

days.topic: Toil Elimination Programmes and Self-Service Operations
subtopics: Avoiding automation that creates new toil
days.lab_task: Build a toil inventory for four teams, fund the top three items, deliver one as a self-service operation and report hours returned.
days.deliverable: Toil programme plan and first self-service operation
checks: Toil is measured across four teams

days.topic: Design Reviews for Reliability: Failure Modes and Architecture Risks
days.lab_task: Review a new payment service design with FMEA, rank its failure modes, agree design changes and track them to completion.
days.deliverable: FMEA, review record and tracked changes
checks: Failure modes are ranked by severity and likelihood
Design changes are agreed for the top risks

days.topic: Security and Reliability Together: Shared Incidents and Safe Defaults
days.lab_task: Run a joint exercise where a leaked credential forces key rotation during an outage, test break-glass access and fix one unsafe default.
days.deliverable: Joint exercise record and fixes
checks: Security and SRE responders work as one team
Break-glass access works and is audited

days.topic: Cost and Reliability: Efficiency Without Losing Nines
subtopics: Cost per request and per journey
days.lab_task: Cut the cost of the course service by 20% with right-sizing and spot capacity while the SLOs hold, and report cost and reliability together.
days.deliverable: Cost reduction with SLO evidence
checks: Monthly cost drops by at least 20%
SLOs stay within budget after the change
Cost and reliability are reported side by side

days.topic: Platform SRE: Reliability of Shared Infrastructure
subtopics: SLOs for platforms and internal services
days.lab_task: Set SLOs for the shared Kubernetes platform and CI system, limit the blast radius of a platform change with staged rollout and run a platform incident review with customer teams.
days.deliverable: Platform SLOs, staged change and review
checks: The platform change rolls out in stages
Customer teams take part in the incident review

days.topic: AI-Assisted Operations at Scale: Agents, Guardrails and Evaluation
subtopics: Where AI agents fit in operations
Agent access to telemetry, code and runbooks
days.lab_task: Evaluate two AI operations agents on twenty replayed incidents, define guardrails for production actions and decide where agents can act without a human.
days.deliverable: Agent evaluation and guardrail policy
checks: Agents are scored on correct diagnosis and safe actions
Production actions follow the guardrail policy
Autonomous actions are limited to proven cases

days.topic: Operational Resilience Regulations: EU DORA, Testing and Reporting
subtopics: The EU Digital Operational Resilience Act and who it applies to
Major incident classification and reporting deadlines
Resilience testing, including threat-led penetration testing
ICT third-party risk and the register of information
UK operational resilience: important business services and impact tolerances
Mapping SRE practices to regulatory duties
days.lab_task: Map the course company's SRE practices to EU DORA and UK operational resilience duties, fill the gaps with owners and prepare an evidence pack for a supervisor.
days.deliverable: Regulatory mapping, gap plan and evidence pack
checks: Each duty maps to a practice or a gap
The evidence pack answers a supervisor's questions

days.topic: Building an SRE Practice: Hiring, Training and Career Paths
days.lab_task: Design hiring loops, a training plan with shadow on-call and a career ladder for the SRE practice, and plan the first year of growth.
days.deliverable: SRE practice plan
checks: Interview loops test the needed skills
New SREs reach on-call readiness through a planned path
The career ladder has clear expectations by level

days.topic: Reliability Case Studies and SRE Practitioner Exam Preparation
subtopics: Applying lessons to your own systems
SRE Practitioner topics: anti-patterns, observability, chaos and AIOps
Mapping course days to exam topics
days.lab_task: Analyse three public outage postmortems, apply one lesson to the course service and complete a timed practice set mapped to the SRE Practitioner topics.
days.deliverable: Case study analysis and practice results
checks: Three outages are analysed for patterns
One lesson changes the course service
The practice set score and weak areas are recorded
objectives: Explain the root cause of a public outage and the control that would have prevented it
Prepare for the SRE Practitioner exam

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Organisation-Wide Reliability Programme
subtopics: Cost, AI operations and practice growth
days.lab_task: Present an organisation-wide reliability programme to the leadership persona with the SRE organisation, strategy and investment case, multi-region and data designs, incident and chaos readiness, regulatory mapping, cost results and AI operations guardrails.
days.deliverable: Reliability programme with evidence and a leadership decision
checks: The investment case uses measured risk
Architecture and data designs pass review
Incident, chaos and regulatory readiness have evidence
